notes: Normalisation X = Z / s with s = max(max row sum, max column sum) = max(17, 18) = 18; total relation T = X (I - X)^-1.

The matrix is one expert’s 0-4 assessment and, unusually, has non-zero diagonal entries (a factor rated as influencing itself). The printed T is reproduced exactly with them, so the method must not silently zero the diagonal; it should warn instead.

Table 2 prints D and R of S6 as 2.286 and 2.133; the row and column sums of the printed T are 2.736 and 2.583. Their difference 0.153 matches the printed D - R, so both are typos (deviations). D + R of S6 follows the typos (4.419 instead of 5.319).
